44:3: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night. Indeed, We are warners.
44:4: In it every wise affair is distinguished.
44:5: By a command from Our presence. Indeed, We are senders.
44:6: As a mercy from your Rabb. Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
44:7: Rabb of the heavens, the earth, and what is between the two, if you are those who know with certainty.
44:8: There is no god but He, He gives life and causes death, your Rabb and the Rabb of your first ancestors.
44:9: Rather, they are playing in doubt.
44:10: Wait for the day that the sky comes with a clear smoke.
44:11: It enshrouds the people; this is a painful punishment.
44:12: 'Our Rabb, remove the punishment from us, indeed we are believers,' they say.
44:13: How can there be an admonition for them, while a clear messenger had already come to them?
44:14: Then they turned away from him and said: 'A taught madman.'
44:15: Indeed, We will remove the punishment a little, indeed you are those who will return.
44:16: That day We will seize with a great seizure, indeed We are exactors of retribution.
44:17: And indeed, before them We also put the people of Pharaoh to trial. A noble messenger came to them.
44:18: 'Deliver to me the servants of Allah, indeed I am a trustworthy messenger to you.
44:19: And do not act haughtily against Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with a clear proof.
44:20: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Rabb and your Rabb from your stoning me.
44:21: And if you do not believe me, then stay away from me.'
44:22: Thereupon he prayed to his Rabb: 'Indeed, these are a guilty people.'
44:23: 'Set out with My servants by night; indeed, you are those who will be pursued.
44:24: And leave the sea at rest, indeed they are an army to be drowned.'
44:25: How many gardens and springs they left behind,
44:26: And crops and noble dwellings they had left,
44:27: And a blessing in which they used to take delight.
44:28: Thus it was, and We caused another people to inherit them.
44:29: And the heaven and the earth did not weep over them, and they were the ones kept waiting.
44:30: And indeed, We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating punishment,
44:31: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was exalted among those who go to excess.
44:32: And indeed, We chose them upon a knowledge above the worlds.
44:33: And We gave them signs in which there was a clear test.
44:35: 'It is nothing but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
44:36: Bring our fathers, if you are truthful,' they say.
44:37: Are they better, or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, indeed they were guilty.
44:38: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between the two as players.
44:39: We did not create them except with truth, but most of them do not know.
44:40: Indeed, the Day of Separation is the meeting place of all of them.
44:41: That day, a friend will not benefit a friend in anything, and they will not be helped,
44:42: Except those upon whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is al-Aziz, ar-Rahim.
44:43: Indeed, it is the tree of Zaqqum.
44:44: The food of the sinner is the tree of Zaqqum, it boils in bellies like molten metal.
44:45: Like molten metal, it boils in bellies,
44:46: Like the boiling of scalding water.
44:47: 'Seize him, then drag him into the midst of Hell.
44:48: Then pour over his head from the punishment of scalding water.
44:49: Taste! Indeed, you are the mighty, the noble.
44:50: Indeed, this was what you were doubting.'
44:51: Indeed, the people of taqwa are in a secure station,
44:53: They wear fine silk and satin, facing one another.
44:54: Thus it is, and We marry them to houris with large black eyes.
44:55: There they are in safety when they ask for every kind of fruit.
44:56: They do not taste death there except the first death, and He has protected them from the punishment of Hell,
44:57: As a bounty from your Rabb. That is the great attainment.
44:58: We have made it easy in your tongue so that they might take admonition.
44:59: So wait, indeed they too are waiting.
